# Module external

| Component | Type | Path | Responsibility | Spec |
|-----------|------|------|----------------|------|
| ExternalSessionScanner | backend service | `src/server/external/external-session-scanner.ts` | Every 2 s, lists the interactive Claude Code sessions of other terminals, with their names and favorite marks, keeps a session whose terminal closed as ended until dismissed or resumed in the client, and notifies additions, changes and removals | `specs/external-session-scanner.md` |
| TranscriptReader | backend service | `src/server/external/transcript-reader.ts` | Finds a session transcript, its subagent files, its workflow subagent files and one subagent file by its agent id, reads subagent metadata, turns its lines (subagent lines on request) into read-only conversation items or gives them parsed, in chunks of limited size, reads the full content of one tool item and gives the main argument of a tool input | `specs/transcript-reader.md` |
| ConversationStreamRoute | REST endpoint (WebSocket) | `src/server/external/conversation-stream-route.ts` | `GET /api/external-sessions/:id/conversation`: all items, then the new ones live | `specs/conversation-stream-route.md` |
| ItemContentRoute | REST endpoint | `src/server/external/item-content-route.ts` | `GET /api/external-sessions/:id/items`: full content of one tool call or tool result | `specs/item-content-route.md` |
| ConversationView | UI component | `src/web/external/ConversationView.tsx` | Read-only view of an external session: subbar with "Git Explorer", "Turn Panel" and one of their panels, footer with "Open in Another Terminal", path and figures, the conversation body in between | `specs/conversation-view.md` |
| ConversationBody | UI component | `src/web/external/ConversationBody.tsx` | Read-only message list from a stream of items: left-aligned messages with square avatars, tool cards with their outcome and full content, "N new messages", updated live, with a new stream every 2 s after a lost one | `specs/conversation-body.md` |
| ResumeHereButton | UI component | `src/web/external/ResumeHereButton.tsx` | Accent "Resume Here": warning (none once the session has ended), then resume of the external session in the client | `specs/resume-here-button.md` |
